    "latest_pointer_order": "published_at_utc, archive_v6_transaction_id, v3_attempt_id, publication_receipt_sha256",
    "corrupt_receipt_behavior": "exclude invalid successor receipt, continue scanning other receipts, surface degraded_fallback_legacy for causally relevant invalid receipts"
